en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, 
(It has been narrated) raising it from them<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
The one who bequeaths with the one-third, it would be reckoned for him from his Zakat’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated in a marfu‘ the following: “‘A’immah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, have said, ‘
If one makes a will about one-third of his legacy it is counted as his Zakat.’”
